info.name: 309_Postman_API Final
info.description:
This API collection provides endpoints for **user management, flight searching, hotel management, and booking services**. It enables users to **register, log in, manage their profiles, search for flights, manage hotels, and book or cancel room reservations**.

**Setup Required:**  
This collection uses environment variables. Before running requests, please create an environment in Postman and assign it to the collection. The routes to add images may require the you to manually add an image yourself.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: This route is used to register a new account. Returns the registered user's details.

exec: // Check if tokens exist in the response

request.description: This route is used to login a user. It will return the accessToken and refreshToken.
This route can be used when you have a valid refreshToken but your accessToken has expired. Upon recieving a valid refreshToken, it returns a new valid accessToken.

item.description: Here we have the requests on how to register an account. Login to recieve an access token and refresh token. As well a refresh path to aquire a new access token given an authentication token.

item.name: User

request.description: This request is used to obtain the info on the current user. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.

This route is used to update a user with new information. Users can change their firstName, lastName, password, and email. At least one of the fields must be filled for an update, any fields not provided will not be provided. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization. Returns all the users information.
This route is used to add a profile picture to the users account. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.

item.description: Here contains methods for getting the user information. You must have the correct access token. We also have methods to update user information, you must have at least one field to update, a user can't change/update their email. Finally, we have a way to change/upload a profile picture for the user.

item.name: Hotels

request.description: This route is used to add a hotel to a users account. Will return information about the newly created hotel. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.
This route is used to add a new room type. It must be associated with a specific hotelId. Returns information on the newly created room type. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.

This route is used to add a new room to a hotel. It must be associated with both a hotel and room type. Returns information about the newly created room. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.

This route is used to get information on all available hotels within the specified time period and at the location. Various other queries can be used to search for hotels. Returns a list of hotels that fit the criteria.
This route is used to add/associate an image to a hotel. It returns a success message on success. Requires a valid accessToken as authorization.
This route is used to get information on a specific room via the roomID. It returns information on the room specified.
This route is used to add an image to a specific room. It returns a success message on success. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.
This route is used to update information on a hotel that has already been created. returns inofmration on the newly updated hotel. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.

item.description: These routes are for users to manipulate, add, and manage their hotels and their rooms.

item.name: Cart

request.description: This route is used to add a request to the cart, it returns the cart item details upon success. Requires a valid accessToken for authorization.
This route is used to validate a credit card's information. Requires a valid accessToken for authorization.
This route returns all the flights the user currently has in their cart. Requires a valid accessToken for authorization.
This route deletes a specific item from their flight cart given the flight cart items id. Requires a valid accessToken for authorization.
This route is used to add a hotel booking item to the users cart. Requires a valid accessToken to authenticate.
This route is used to get all the hotel bookings that have been saved in the users cart. Requires a valid accessToken to authorize.
This route is used to delete a hotel booking item from the users cart. Requires a valid accessToken to authenticate

item.description: Here contains the routes that are used for adding/removing/checking items in the user's cart

item.name: Booking

request.description: This route is used to book a flight. It returns barebones information on the bookings. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.
This route is used to check a flight booking. It returns detailed information on the booking.

request.description: This route is used to book a hotel room. It requires the desired room type and date of stay. Returns information on the booking. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.
This route is used to get information on booked hotel rooms. Returns information on the hotel booking requested. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.
This route is used to get all the bookings that a user has made. It returns a list containing information on all their bookings, hotel and flights. Requires a valid accessToken as authentication.

item.description: This section contains all the routes used to book flights and hotels, as well as any routes to view your bookings.

response.name: GetNotifications Response
